text: Bitcoin is holding relatively steady near $77k while Ethereum has pulled back more sharply, suggesting selective profit-taking in altcoins despite an overall greedy market sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 61 remains in greed territory but has retreated 12 points over the week, indicating cooling enthusiasm despite $49B in daily volume. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 58.9% reflects capital rotating toward the largest asset as conviction around the broader rally softens.
